final_message:
Built an audit trail for changes to refunds, customers, tenants and users: a new `audit_log` table and `record_audit_event` function, five edited write paths, and policies `AUDIT-001` and `AUDIT-002` (both advisory). Dry run is clean. Confidence: medium. Access reviews and change approvals can't be checked by any policy.

Files are in `./workspace` and `./out/` (`reply.md`, `notes.json`). Nothing was pushed. Things to decide before pushing:
- `me` (PATCH) accepts a `role` input and writes it to `users`, so a user could promote themselves. I flagged this but did not change it.
- Role checks on admin endpoints are the next control if you want one; I didn't build it because it touches every admin endpoint.
